summary: The uniqueness half of the file is already in TauCeti: `TauCeti.ae_eq_zero_of_forall_moment_eq_zero` is stated for an arbitrary `Measure ℝ` and instantiates at `volume.restrict (Icc a b)` to give `ae_eq_zero_of_forall_setIntegral_Icc_pow_mul_eq_zero` verbatim, which makes the whole Weierstrass route in this PR redundant scaffolding.
